params.prompt:
ONE UNBROKEN CONTINUOUS SHOT, first frame to last: a single take with no cuts. One smooth gimbal camera keeps the airplane in view. Photorealistic live action, 16:9.
The airplane is the plain white dart from the airplane reference: crisply, completely folded from blank A4 (no print, no logo), long sharp nose, two flat identical swept-back wings, sharp creases, neat keel, never crumpled or half-folded. It flies nose first on one smooth continuous path, never jumps, flips or reverses, turns only in slow gentle curves, and never changes shape or size.
Sunny late morning, same warm sunlight direction throughout, no flicker.
Festival ground = the two festival references, identical layout: a natural green GRASS soccer pitch with striped mowing and white lines inside a red running track; at the FAR end the festival stage with a white truss roof and white tents on both sides; four blocks of black chairs in front of the stage; a small black sound booth in the centre circle; long rows of white booth tents along both sides of the track; the green inflatable air arch standing at the track gate on the NEAR curve, not on the grass; outside the track, nearest the school: in front of the arch a road, then a wide open lawn block, then the paved lot with SIX colourful food trucks in one straight row and the yellow parasol tables below them (school side); a straight road runs from the junction in front of the arch toward the school between that lot and a plain lawn; only one goal at the near end of the pitch; a bus and trucks on the road; red, green and orange bean bags ONLY on the lawn between the near-right curve of the track and the road where the bus and trucks are parked (track side of that road, just right of the arch); the lawn on the school side of that road is plain grass; green trees and apartment blocks behind. The festival is busy and joyful: hundreds of students fill the ground, browsing and chatting at the booth tents, queuing and eating at the food trucks and parasol tables, lounging and laughing on the bean bags, posing for photos at the air arch, sitting together in the chair blocks and walking around in small groups; always small, seen from above or behind, no recognisable faces.
Clear deep blue sky above the same school.
Continue the reference video seamlessly from its very last frame as the SAME continuous shot: the first frame keeps the same camera position, the same airplane position and heading, the same location and the same light as the last frame of the reference video.
START STATE: Seen from just behind and slightly above, the airplane glides along the right long side of the red track beside the row of white booth tents full of students, heading toward the school end.
The whole flight below is ONE unbroken take in this exact order, with natural, unhurried pacing and no fixed timing; each stage flows smoothly into the next with no cut:
1. Continuing the reference video without any cut, at the same low height, the airplane glides on along the right long side of the red track beside the row of white booth tents full of students, toward the school end, gradually lowering to just above head height. The camera stays about two metres behind it.
2. Past the near-right corner of the track it keeps gliding in one wide, smooth leftward arc, never turning back sharply: over the road in front of the green air arch and across the wide open lawn block, toward the WEST end of the food-truck lot.
3. Still turning gently left, it glides EASTWARD along the straight row of six colourful food trucks, a few metres above the students queuing in front of them; all six trucks stay the same throughout. It does not fly toward the school building.
4. At the end of the truck row it crosses the straight road and curves gently left, gliding along the road past the parked bus and trucks, then over the lawn on the track side of that road where students lounge on red, green and orange bean bags, seen only from above and behind.
5. From the bean bags it curves gently left along the track fence to the green inflatable air arch at the track gate and flies straight through the middle of the arch, well above the head of anyone nearby; the camera passes through right behind it.
6. Inside the track it rises a little and glides clearly above the crossbar of the single near goal, then low across the grass pitch past the sound booth, above the heads of the many students sitting in the black chair blocks, heading straight for the stage.
7. Only now does it rise: the airplane climbs smoothly over the white truss roof of the stage and keeps climbing straight up into the deep blue sky; the camera tilts up following it, the frame fills with bright sunlight and glows to pure white.
FINAL FRAME: The frame is entirely bright white light.
Audio: diegetic only: lively festival ambience (many voices chatting, gentle laughter, food-truck sizzle, footsteps), paper flutter, a rising airy breeze as the light grows.
Negative: no cuts or scene changes, no jump in time, no teleporting, reversing or tail-first airplane, no airplane shape change, no extra airplanes, no text, subtitles, watermarks or logos, no flicker, no change of location design, no music, no dirt field, no soccer match, no high aerial drone view before the stage, no jumping to another place, no close-up or recognisable faces, no raised hands or cheering, no airplane skimming the ground, no change of the festival layout, no air arch on the grass, no fireworks, no stage performance, no turning back to look at places already passed, no bean bags on the school side of the road, no second goal, no purple or pink sky, no dissolve or crossfade, no transparent or ghosted objects.
